cases.title: a flow that suspends is refused at load
a suspend in a body or the failure module is refused
without the contract entry, the subflow's suspend fails the load
with it, the subflow is opaque and the site keeps its envelope

given.contract:
roots:
  - flow: f/x/main
provided:
  - selector: {flow: f/x/main, module: permit}
    provider: approval
    mandatory: true

cases.title: a mandatory selector that matches two sites is ambiguous

files.f/x/main.flow/flow.yaml:
value:
  modules:
    - id: permit
      skip_if: {expr: 'flow_input.skip'}
      stop_after_if: {expr: 'result.denied', skip_if_stopped: false, error_message: denied}
      retry: {constant: {attempts: 2, seconds: 1}}
      continue_on_error: true
      value:
        type: flow
        path: f/x/permit
        input_transforms:
          who: {type: javascript, expr: flow_input.user}
    - id: o
      value:
        type: branchone
        branches: []
        default:
          - id: permit
            value: {type: flow, path: f/x/permit}

given.contract:
roots:
  - flow: f/x/main
provided:
  - selector: {flow: f/x/main, module: permit}
    provider: approval
    mandatory: true

cases.note: p's content and lock files are absent, q's content is not UTF-8, and r's content reference leaves the sync root; the case without the contract entries fails on each.
cases.title: a provided rawscript's inline files are never read

files.f/x/main.flow/flow.yaml:
value:
  modules:
    - id: p
      value:
        type: rawscript
        language: bun
        content: '!inline absent.ts'
        lock: '!inline absent.lock'
        input_transforms: {}
    - id: q
      value:
        type: rawscript
        language: bun
        content: '!inline bad.ts'
        input_transforms: {}
    - id: r
      value:
        type: rawscript
        language: bun
        content: '!inline ../../../../outside.ts'
        input_transforms: {}

given.contract:
roots:
  - flow: f/x/main
provided:
  - selector: {flow: f/x/main, module: p}
    provider: host
    mandatory: true
  - selector: {flow: f/x/main, module: q}
    provider: host
    mandatory: true
  - selector: {flow: f/x/main, module: r}
    provider: host
    mandatory: true

files.f/x/sub.flow/flow.yaml:

    - id: p

contains: must be a script, flow or rawscript step

note: Durable suspend is out of scope (0001 §3), unless every path to it passes through a mandatory host-provided call site. The provided-site cases are the compile-time half of 0002's provided-site policy case; the run-time half is F2a's.
